text:
Maya: FYI — SageBridge flagged for renewal triage. Usage down ~62% MoM, procurement says they're running a competitive eval. Need quick coord. :warning:

AlertBot: account_health_alert | account: SageBridge | metric: usage_drop_30d | drop_pct: 62% | severity: medium

Priya: I pulled logs — embeddings traffic tanked (their search/recall). Generation endpoints normal. They kicked off a competitor 'fast-embeds' trial on 2026-03-02. Links in internal logs.

Liam: Who's the procurement contact now? New decision lead?

Maya: Procurement swapped in Evelyn two weeks ago. Their champion (data eng) is less engaged after PoC. Evelyn is looped here.

Evelyn: Confirmed. We're evaluating a vendor bundling embeddings + analytics at lower headline cost. Not cancelling yet, just exploring. Need clearer cost breakdowns.

Priya: Competitor uses batched approximate embeddings to cut calls. We can match cost gains with either a quantized embed model + prefix/KV caching.

Evan: For a Dedicated trial we can enable SSO + audit logs and set token caps via rate-limit policies.

Liam: Proposed play:
1) Offer 30-day Dedicated eval (small reserved pool) with audit logs & token caps
2) Provide tailored cost analysis + endpoint optimization
3) Run enablement with their engineers to cover caching/batching
Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Priya: I'll draft a short runbook (prompt edits, quantization knobs, caching flags). Quick sample cost calc below:

```
SageBridge baseline (30d):
- embed calls: 1.2M
- gen tokens: 4.8M
- est spend: $6,400
After caching + quantized embed model:
- embed calls (effective): 0.5M
- gen tokens: 4.8M
- est spend: $3,900
Savings: ~39% on embedding spend
```

Maya: Action items —
- Liam: schedule customer meeting (procurement + champion)
- Priya: runbook + sample cost report (ETA EOD Mon)
- Evan: confirm Dedicated config for trial (SSO, logs, token caps)
- Maya: update renewal flag & assemble one-pager for exec sponsor

Liam: Scheduling 30-min meeting Tue 10am PT, inviting Evelyn + data eng. Invite sent.

Evelyn: Tue 10am PT works. Please include expected endpoints and sample trial terms (token caps, SLA).

Priya: Quick tech ask — can procurement share top 3 query/endpoint patterns and any hard latency SLAs? That informs caching strategy.

Evelyn: Sharing a short doc in the invite. Latency target for interactive search is <200ms p95.

Evan: We can hit <200ms p95 on Dedicated for their small pilot with the right instance + prefix caching. I'll draft a config snippet for the call.

Maya: If Priya/Evan can have runbook + config ready pre-call we can do a live demo — better for procurement.

Priya: Will deliver EOD Monday. Recommend prefix caching + 8-bit quant for embed model for pilot.

Liam: Evelyn accepted the invite.

Maya: Updating Gainsight to 'At-risk — active mitigation'. Will paste meeting notes after call.

Evelyn: Appreciate the quick turnaround. If trial includes token caps, audit logs, and a clear cost breakdown, procurement will prioritize.

Maya: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after the enablement/demo. :thumbsup:
